decisions.statement: One `git cat-file --batch` answers every body asked for.
The answer comes back as bytes rather than as text.
A path the commit does not have answers as nothing.
A base that names no commit is said out loud.
Whether a base names a commit is answered without a body being asked for.
A base the reader already asked after is not asked again.
A tree the reader already walked is not walked again.
A body is asked for by its object name rather than by its path.
A path no tree the commit has names is answered without an ask.
The reader is kept between calls and ended where a call throws.
A reader that has answered enough bytes is retired for a fresh reader.
A reader is ended as the process exits.
The text git says on the error stream is carried into the error thrown.
The commit is named by the caller asking.

definition: the body a commit holds at a path, read without a git run for each one
